_readme: Store listings from All The Places that the chain's own page or location data shows as closed or not open, where nothing in the source data says so. Entries are added one by one when someone finds such a store (no automatic sweep). Each entry names the source record (spider + ref), the reason, the page that proves it, and the date it was checked. The pipeline leaves these out. Like data/overrides.json: no entry without a source.
